career.title: Career Profile
career.subtitle: Your central source of professional information for resumes, cover letters and future career tools.
career.onboardingPrompt: Set your career direction and review your professional information.
career.completenessHint: {{completed}} of {{total}} essential sections completed. Awards, certifications and links are optional.
career.uploadHint: PDF, DOCX or TXT, up to 8 MB. Sent to our existing AI provider for extraction. The file is not stored by CVcomet. Review the draft before saving.
career.imported: Extraction ready. Existing information was kept; new information has been added to this draft. Review every section before saving.
career.scratchHint: You can enter your information in the next step. Only add information that applies to you.
career.reviewHint: Check all information and leave unknown fields empty. Nothing from the import is saved until you confirm. Your account email is retained.
career.confirm: I have reviewed and corrected this information and confirm that it is accurate.
career.emptySection: No entries yet. Add one if it applies to you.
career.skillsHint: List only skills you have, separated by commas or lines.
career.languagesHint: Include each language and your actual level. Leave the level unspecified if unknown.
career.aiReview: Check that every statement remains accurate. You can edit or reject this suggestion. Accepting changes only your draft; save your profile to keep it.
career.changedSource: Your original text changed while this suggestion was being prepared. Close this dialog and try again.
